description: This file contains a unit test class for the OrderController, specifically testing the behavior of the 'My Orders' page when accessed by an anonymous user. The test verifies that the response is a redirect to the login page, using an HTTP client created through the application's test fixture.

classes.name: OrderIndexOnGet
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the Order controller's index page for anonymous users, ensuring proper redirection to login.

methods.name: OrderIndexOnGet
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the HTTP client for testing, initializing it with specific options to prevent auto-redirects.

methods.name: ReturnsRedirectGivenAnonymousUser
methods.description: Test method that sends a GET request to the '/order/my-orders' endpoint and asserts that the response is a redirect to the login page.
